name: Navier-Stokes Fire Simulation
definition: Physics-based algorithms representing fire as hot and turbulent gas. A efficient method involves solving volumetric differential equations at low resolutions, specifically the full 3D finite difference solution of Navier-Stokes equations.
summary: Navier-Stokes Fire Simulation models fire as turbulent gas by solving fluid dynamics equations, distinguishing itself through physically accurate convection and buoyancy rather than procedural noise.
